criteria_results.title: Withdrawal notice period reduced to 15 calendar days or fewer
criteria_results.reasoning: Redline §7.1 and §7.2 change withdrawal notice to fifteen (15) calendar days.

criteria_results.title: Return-or-destroy obligation for withdrawing party modified or deleted
criteria_results.reasoning: Redline §7.2(b) modifies return-or-destroy to original shared form with carve-outs.

criteria_results.title: Work-product incorporation exception added to withdrawal materials obligation
criteria_results.reasoning: §7.2(b) provides no obligation to return/destroy JDM reviewed and incorporated into Incorporated Work Product (defined in new §1.8).

criteria_results.title: Settlement advance notice period reduced to 10 business days or fewer
criteria_results.reasoning: §9.2 reduces notice to ten (10) business days, triggered by determination to proceed.

criteria_results.title: Settlement disclosure limited to existence and general nature
criteria_results.reasoning: §9.2 limits Settlement Notice to existence and general nature, items (a)-(c), and bars disclosure of amount, releases, cooperation terms.

criteria_results.title: Confidentiality survival period extended to at least 7 years or made indefinite
criteria_results.reasoning: §8.1 makes confidentiality survival indefinite.

criteria_results.title: Conflicts waiver carve-out preserving right to assert claims against JDA members in future litigation
criteria_results.reasoning: New §11.3 reserves each Party's right to assert claims against other Parties in any present or future proceeding.

criteria_results.title: Conflicts waiver carve-out specifically includes contribution and indemnity actions
criteria_results.reasoning: §11.3 expressly lists claims for contribution and contractual or equitable indemnity.

criteria_results.title: Governing law changed from New York to Illinois
criteria_results.reasoning: §12.3 changed to Illinois law.

criteria_results.title: New inadvertent-disclosure or clawback provision added
criteria_results.reasoning: New §3.6 adds inadvertent disclosure and clawback provision.

criteria_results.title: Clawback provision references FRE 502(d) or provides equivalent contractual mechanism
criteria_results.reasoning: §3.6(a) requires a joint FRE 502(d) motion and §3.6(b) provides a four-element contractual clawback.

criteria_results.title: Government-investigation carve-out provision added
criteria_results.reasoning: New §4.5 lets any Party withhold materials responsive to any Government Investigation without breach or disclosure of its existence.

criteria_results.title: Express right to object to or decline information-sharing requests added
criteria_results.reasoning: New §4.4 gives an express right to object to and decline information-sharing requests.

criteria_results.title: Information-sharing objection grounds include work-product, separate-interest privilege, or regulatory sensitivity
criteria_results.reasoning: §4.4 grounds: individual work product, separate-interest privilege, and regulatory sensitivity.

criteria_results.title: Blanket conflicts waiver identified as Prohibited or never-accept term in issues memo
criteria_results.reasoning: Memo Issue 8 classifies the blanket conflicts waiver as Prohibited/never-accept under Playbook §6.3.

criteria_results.title: Blanket conflicts waiver assigned highest or most severe risk rating
criteria_results.reasoning: Issue 8 is rated Critical, the highest rating in the memo's scale.

criteria_results.title: Material settlement terms disclosure identified as Prohibited or never-accept term in issues memo
criteria_results.reasoning: Issue 5 classifies 'all material terms' disclosure as Prohibited/never-accept (§4.4).

criteria_results.title: Material settlement terms disclosure assigned highest or most severe risk rating
criteria_results.reasoning: Issue 5 is rated Critical, the highest rating.

criteria_results.title: Issues memo distinguishes Required, Preferred, and Prohibited playbook classifications
criteria_results.reasoning: Memo assigns Required, Preferred, and Prohibited tiers per issue in the summary table and analysis.

criteria_results.title: Cost-sharing allocation flagged as deviation from playbook
criteria_results.reasoning: Issue 12 flags the fixed 50/16.67 split as a disfavored deviation from the pro rata damages-based, quarterly recalculated standard.

criteria_results.title: Steering committee composition flagged as deviation from playbook
criteria_results.reasoning: Issue 14 flags the permanent Kerrigan-Holst seat, single rotating seat and elected seat as disfavored versus equal representation.

criteria_results.title: Dispute resolution clause flagged as deviation from playbook
criteria_results.reasoning: Issue 15 flags binding JAMS NY arbitration without mediation as disfavored versus mediation then N.D. Ill. litigation.

criteria_results.title: Post-settlement cooperation obligation flagged as deviation from playbook
criteria_results.reasoning: Issue 16 flags the 18-month commercially-reasonable-efforts cooperation as disfavored versus preservation-only.

criteria_results.title: Risk ratings assigned to each identified deviation
criteria_results.reasoning: Every issue in the summary table and detailed analysis carries a risk rating (Critical/High/Medium/Low/Compliant).

criteria_results.title: Recommended position or alternative language provided for each deviation
criteria_results.reasoning: Each issue includes a Recommended position/redline entry and recommended action in the table.

criteria_results.title: Reference to Vantage JDA Playbook v4.2 (September 15, 2024) as benchmark
criteria_results.reasoning: Memo references Playbook v4.2 as the benchmark and its date September 15, 2024 (Part III.F).

criteria_results.title: Underlying case name referenced in issues memo
criteria_results.reasoning: Memo RE line names In re Industrial Fasteners Antitrust Litigation.

criteria_results.title: Underlying case number referenced in issues memo
criteria_results.reasoning: Memo cites No. 1:23-cv-04871.

criteria_results.title: Underlying court referenced in issues memo
criteria_results.reasoning: Memo cites N.D. Ill.

criteria_results.title: Absence of limitation-of-liability clause flagged as missing protection
criteria_results.reasoning: Issue 20 flags absence of limitation of liability and proposes new §12.11.

criteria_results.title: Scope definition addressing government investigations modified in redline
criteria_results.reasoning: Redline §1.6 adds proviso routing Government Investigations to §4.5 carve-out, and §2.1 adds a caveat that no sharing is required for Government Investigations.
